title: Apple Announces Product Launch Event for October 28
excerpt: Apple has sent out invitations for a second product launch event this month, scheduled for October 28 in Los Angeles.
body_html:
Apple has invited guests to a second product launch event scheduled for October 28 at 1 PM Eastern Time in Los Angeles.

According to reports, the company is expected to reveal new Mac computers alongside an updated iPad Mini during the gathering. The primary focus of the event is anticipated to be a new MacBook Pro featuring an OLED display.

This upcoming presentation follows another product launch held earlier in the month.
